amends: nba-multimarket-research-1.3 (two fixes from docs/nba_auditoria_motor_20261021.md); RUN071, v1.2, v1.3 and the live v1.3 cohort untouched
inherits: multimarket_v13_protocol.json and multimarket_v12_protocol.json (sources, T-60 rule, windows, models, ridge priors, seeds, bootstrap, reference lines)

fix_1_relative_missing.form_window: the same team window v1.2 uses for home_mean/away_mean: the team's last 20 games strictly before the game date within 370 days
fix_1_relative_missing.share_played: fraction of those team games in which the listed player participated (minutes > 0) for that same team; 0 when he played none of them
fix_1_relative_missing.expected_missing_minutes: sum over listed players of trailing_minutes * (share_played - play_probability)
fix_1_relative_missing.expected_missing_points: sum over listed players of trailing_points * (share_played - play_probability)
fix_1_relative_missing.sign: negative values allowed: a listed player likely to play who missed part of the window is a return
fix_1_relative_missing.unlisted_players: contribute nothing, as in v1.3 (a player absent from the report may have left the roster)
fix_1_relative_missing.player_markets: teammates_expected_missing_minutes uses the same relative definition

fix_2_g_league.rule: a report row whose reason contains 'G League' (Two-Way or On Assignment) goes to its own category 'G League', whatever its raw status
fix_2_g_league.play_probability: Beta(1,1) smoothed participation rate per category over the training window, refit per target season (same estimator as v1.3)
fix_2_g_league.own_player_flags: own_questionable_or_doubtful and own_probable are false for 'G League' rows

primary_comparison: v1.4 vs v1.3 on identical rows, test seasons 2024-25 and 2025-26 only; paired Brier difference with 95% date bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 20261021)
secondary: log loss and bias per market
winner and team-points weights on missing points (expected to grow in magnitude if double counting diluted them)
participation log loss of the v1.4 status table vs the v1.3 table on the same listed rows
decision_rule: fixes are kept only if v1.4 is not worse than v1.3 in winner and team_points in both test seasons (upper CI bound <= 0.0005); improvement is reported, not promoted
promotion: none; retrospective, seasons already inspected with v1.1-v1.3, exploratory; the live module keeps v1.3 until a separate change
not_modeled: report timing beyond the T-60 rule (one report per day in history)
